## Classification Rules

- `KEEP_CORE_CODE`: algorithm/source/test/script/config/docs needed to run or validate the research code.
- `KEEP_DATA`: graph datasets and attribute metadata needed to reproduce experiments.
- `KEEP_RESULTS`: non-empty experiment results, reports, logs, plots, caches, and comparison outputs retained for research comparison.
- `REVIEW_MANUALLY`: ambiguous local settings, generated test artifacts, or utilities that may be useful but should not be moved automatically.
- `SAFE_TO_DELETE`: only generated bytecode/cache artifacts, zero-byte logs, and clearly empty generated/cache folders. These will be moved to `_cleanup_quarantine/`, not deleted.
